tldr: Venus in Libra: love seeks harmony, beauty, fairness, and mutuality.
body: With Venus in Libra, Venus is at home, so relationship intelligence, social grace, and aesthetic balance are strong. You value partnership that feels reciprocal and elegant.
gift: Diplomacy, charm, fairness, artistic taste, and the ability to create relational ease.
challenge: People-pleasing, indecision, and keeping the peace while betraying your own values.
note: Authored from approved project planet-through-sign material.
